recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future work is only needed if a new work-group decision changes Task insurance semantics or requests additional search parameters/examples; FHIR-17360 itself is already represented in the current build source.
issue_request: FHIR-17360 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Task and asked to add Task.insurance as part of the Request pattern so coverage, pre-authorizations, and related insurance information could be associated with a Task for DaVinci use cases.
initial_application: Git commit 99532b4c0a6c05d7f6d3176df90ba33f1940abbc included GF#17360 and added a Task.insurance row to the historical Task spreadsheet with 0..* Reference(Coverage|ClaimResponse), the associated insurance coverage short text, the insurance/pre-authorization definition, and Request.insurance/v2/RIM mappings. Later refactoring converted the resource source to source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml, where blame attributes the current Task.insurance lines to c1dda1d5fd1c53b64abb0f0eb8d68392621895cd.
additional_context: Task is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Task StructureDefinition contains Task.insurance with cardinality 0..*, type Reference(Coverage|ClaimResponse), the Request.insurance workflow mapping, and the same insurance/pre-authorization definition. The R4 published profile also contains the element with the same shape. OO Zulip and Confluence block-vote evidence records GF#17360 as Persuasive and accepted 8-0-2, and searches found no later directly relevant reversal or conflicting Task.insurance decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current in-build source already implements the requested element and mappings.
